messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning Q4 webinar + competitive playbook refresh. Need tight narrative vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors, plus routing for inbound leads. Can we sketch the north-star by EOD?
aj: On it. Can you drop the current deck and the recent benchmark slides? I’ll riff on messaging bullets.
maria: Dropped in the channel: https://drive.redwood/marketing/q4-playbook-v1 (view only for now). Key ask: punchy 3-line value props vs (1) managed cloud APIs (2) LLM API vendors (3) infra-only runtimes.
devon: Quick draft for bullets — feel free to shorten:
- vs managed cloud: we give same dev DX with predictable unit economics + fallback routing to cheaper quantized models.
- vs LLM APIs: we provide deployment parity across hosted/dedicated/private — same SDK, same telemetry, no surprise performance cliffs.
- vs infra vendors: we own the orchestration + smart routing (latency SLOs, KV cache) so teams don’t stitch runtime + ops.
samir: Routing + SDR handoff idea: map inbound intent -> model tier -> SLA -> lead severity. Example:
- demo request + enterprise domain -> Dedicated/Private -> 1wk SLA -> high-touch AE
- trial usage spike + dev org -> Hosted + onboarding email + SDR triage -> mid-touch
- research question -> self-serve docs + forum -> low-touch
I can turn this into a simple flow for the landing form.
elaine: For the webinar headline options (short):
- "Serving LLMs in Production: Predictable Performance, Lower Cost"
- "Redwood Runtime: Same API. Better Economics."
- "From Lab to Latency SLA — Scale LLMs Without the Ops Tax"
My pick: option 3 — resonates with platform teams.
aj: Copy edit: change ‘Ops Tax’ to ‘Ops Overhead’ for external comms. Ops Tax is a bit internal-y. :+1:
launch-bot: Reminder: Webinar calendar created for 2027-11-28 10:00 PT — RSVP & draft landing page need approvals.
maria: @devon @samir please pair on a one-pager (single A4) that contains: 3 competitor callouts, 3 customer-facing talking points, and the inbound routing matrix. Target: tomorrow 5pm.
devon: I’ll take competitor callouts and customer bullets. Samir can you own the routing matrix?
samir: Yep, I’ll mock the form rules. Quick sketch in code form to iterate:
```
if (inbound.intent == 'enterprise_demo') { route.to = 'AE_high'; priority = 'p0'; /* email + slack alert */ }
else if (inbound.usage > 1_000_000_tokens) { route.to = 'platform_eng'; priority = 'p1'; }
else { route.to = 'self_serve'; priority = 'p3'; }
```
elaine: Also need 2 short benchmark callouts for the webinar slides — latency vs clouds (p95), and unit cost delta for typical chat workloads. Can we get numbers from infra ops by EOD?
aj: Pinged ops in #eng-infra. They said they’ll push a trimmed table by 3pm.
maria: Awesome. If we have the numbers + one-pager tomorrow we can lock the webinar landing copy and run a dry rehearsal next week. Thanks all. :rocket:
